PDF.js 6.5.438, Mozilla Foundation, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438
Documentation: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/

Vendored from pdfjs-dist: legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs,
renamed to .js so existing servers serve JavaScript MIME types without restarting.
Includes unmodified cmaps, standard_fonts and wasm assets and their licenses.
The optional renderer worker is not enabled. No third-party CDN requests are needed.
